skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental principles of real estate economics, including market relationships, financial relations, and policy implications.
Develop skills in research, analysis, synthesis, and generalization of real estate economic issues.
Analyze and explain the mechanisms of market relationships and economic choices in real estate.
Work independently and in groups to solve real estate economic problems.
Effectively communicate research findings and economic analysis in presentations and reports.
Demonstrate the ability to self-study and independently research topics in real estate economics.
Understand and respect ethical and social responsibilities in the field of real estate economics.
